shared_elements: human figure in profile with elaborately patterned hair/beard
stylized tree with regular repeated foliage units
low-relief figures facing in one direction
justification: Both show profile human figures with the same conventions of curled patterned hair and beard, fringed robes and a schematic tree built of repeated rosette/leaf units, and in both a figure carries a handled vessel-like object beside that tree, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest differences in content are the large feathered wings and single vertical panel composition in B versus the horizontal procession of men leading horned rams framed by rosette borders in A.
